reels.caption:
If you want details of this exact stay, comment "villa" and I'll DM it to you.

We found this villa on Airbnb after going deep into options to get the location and property right. ₹1895 per person per night (shared between 4), so around ₹7500 for the entire villa without food. We were eating out most of the time anyway, so it worked out.

If it's your first time, where you stay will define your trip.
Seminyak for walkable, central, easy.
Canggu for a slower, café-heavy vibe.
Uluwatu for views and beach clubs, but expect travel.
Planning Nusa Penida? Stay closer to Sanur for easier ferry access.

Bali is a traveller's dream, but it's also crowded. You feel it quickly. What changes everything is finding your own pocket within it.

Save this so future you isn't 15 tabs deep, confused between Seminyak and Canggu, trying to pick the perfect villa stay.
